snippet.title: Brave Frontier: The Last Summoner - Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Play NOW on iOS → apple.co/2xdjxob
Play NOW on Android → bit.ly/2Q3Xzvv

In this epic trailer for Brave Frontier: The Last Summoner, animated by Tatsunoko Production Co., Ltd., watch as Brook, Lavender and friends take on the Vorderia Empire to unveal the many secrets of the world of Vask! Pre-Register now on Google Play: http://bit.ly/2Q7DdkW (Soon on Apple Store!).

*****
Brave Frontier: The Last Summoner lets your wildest JRPG dreams come true as you get full control over up to 25 characters in a single battle, whether you're advancing the story or competing in real-time PVP matches! Feel the freedom of a completely customizable experience as you obtain fantastic weapons, unlock exceptional skills and obliterate enemies with style thanks to an impressive cast of stylish characters! Jump into a brave new world set in the Brave Frontier extended universe -  an iconic franchise played by millions - and become the legendary general you were always meant to be!

*****
